import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
credit_fraud = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Plot the distribution of amounts for fraud and non-fraud transactions
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.histplot(x='amount', hue='is_fraud', data=credit_fraud, bins=20, kde=True)
plt.title('Distribution of Transaction Amounts by Fraud Status')
plt.xlabel('Amount')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.legend(title='Fraud Status')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()
